title: Decode OpenAI-compatible streamed tool calls
goal: Preserve function-call deltas from OpenAI-compatible SSE streams as validated semantic toolCall events instead of silently discarding them.
context: Palvia's useful donor pattern is incremental tool-call accumulation. PersonalAgent already defines LLMStreamEvent.toolCall, but ChatCompletionsStreamDecoder currently reads only delta.content and therefore discards provider tool calls.
forbidden_changes: Do not import or copy Palvia's app-specific models or UI.
Do not execute tools or bypass Skill/Module permission and approval boundaries.
Do not modify App UI, Package.swift, Xcode project, or unrelated provider contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Incremental SSE decoding accumulates fragmented tool names and argument JSON by tool index.
A tool-only completion is accepted only with a terminal marker and valid JSON arguments.
Malformed tool arguments and truncated streams fail closed.
Existing text streaming regression tests remain compatible.
verification: M3 and Apple Native Build checks
recovery: Revert the single task commit if streaming regressions appear; keep tool execution disabled until a separate integration task routes events through existing authorization and verification.
